label: C3 families with six outer and three inner tiles
description: Nine-tile weak-problem structures extracted from the C3 6+3 schematic specification.

variants.label: C3 6+3 S3 - disjoint inner tiles
variants.description: The inner tiles have no positive-length mutual contacts; alternating outer tiles reach the central junction.

variants.label: C3 6+3 S3b - boundary points
variants.description: S3 with three inner tiles reaching the disk boundary at points, opening three alternating outer-cycle contacts.

variants.label: C3 6+3 T2 - inner triangle, external degree 2
variants.description: The inner tiles form a triangle and each inner tile has positive-length contacts with two outer tiles.

variants.label: C3 6+3 T3 - inner triangle, external degree 3
variants.description: The inner tiles form a triangle and each inner tile has positive-length contacts with three outer tiles.

variants.label: C3 6+3 T2b - boundary points
variants.description: T2 with three inner boundary-point contacts and three opened alternating outer-cycle contacts.

variants.label: C3 6+3 T3b - boundary points
variants.description: T3 with three inner boundary-point contacts and three opened alternating outer-cycle contacts.
